page.noteFindProcess: Process identification requires find-process-mode: always; otherwise traffic is grouped under Unknown process.
page.noteHistory: History is only accumulated from when this feature starts counting; traffic from before that cannot be backfilled. Counting runs while this page is open, in snapshot ticks, so the last increment before a connection closes may not be counted.
page.noteMihomo: Only traffic passing through the Mihomo core is counted.
